from pathlib import Path
prog='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Reconstruct a periodic sequence from complete horizontal stripes.
    rows = [(r, grid[r][0]) for r in range(h)
            if grid[r][0] != 0 and all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])]
    if rows:
        period = len(rows)
        by_residue = {r % period: color for r, color in rows}
        if len(by_residue) == period:
            return [[by_residue[r % period] for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

    # Otherwise extend the periodic diagonal stripes (constant column-row).
    diagonals = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color != 0:
                d = c - r
                if d in diagonals and diagonals[d] != color:
                    raise ValueError("input has inconsistent diagonal stripes")
                diagonals[d] = color
    period = len(diagonals)
    by_residue = {d % period: color for d, color in diagonals.items()}
    if len(by_residue) != period:
        raise ValueError("diagonal stripe residues do not define a period")
    return [[by_residue[(c - r) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); p.write_text(prog)
